contexts.description: Phoenix Contexts for bounded domain logic

required_patterns.boundary-enforcement: All database operations go through context modules (Goals, Accounts, Auth, Groups)
required_patterns.changeset-validation: All data mutations use Ecto changesets with proper validations
required_patterns.ownership-validation: Functions ending with _with_ownership validate user_id matches resource owner
required_patterns.preloading: Related data is preloaded through context functions, not in LiveViews

architectural_constraints.no-repo-in-web: Repo is never called directly from LiveViews or controllers
architectural_constraints.context-owns-schema: Each schema belongs to a single context that manages its lifecycle
architectural_constraints.error-tuples: Functions return {:ok, result} or {:error, reason} tuples

services.description: Service modules for complex business logic and cross-cutting concerns

required_patterns.single-responsibility: Services handle one domain concern (ActivityService for XP/levels, FeedService for feeds)
required_patterns.transaction-wrapping: Complex operations use Repo.transaction for atomicity
required_patterns.helper-functions: Private helper functions handle calculations and transformations

architectural_constraints.no-side-effects-in-helpers: Private functions are pure; side effects happen in public functions
architectural_constraints.stateless: Services are stateless modules, no GenServer state

required_patterns.assign-pattern: Use assign/3 for state, assigns are accessed via @variable in templates
required_patterns.event-handling: All user interactions go through handle_event/3
required_patterns.pubsub-subscription: Subscribe to PubSub topics in mount when connected?(socket)
required_patterns.on-mount-auth: Authentication via on_mount hooks defined in router live_session

architectural_constraints.no-blocking-mount: mount/3 should be fast; defer data loading to connected state
architectural_constraints.socket-assigns: All state stored in socket assigns, no module attributes for state
architectural_constraints.context-calls: Call context modules for data operations, never Repo directly
architectural_constraints.embedded-templates: Templates can be embedded via render/1 function with ~H sigil

live-components.description: Stateful LiveComponents for reusable interactive UI

required_patterns.update-callback: Implement update/2 to receive assigns from parent
required_patterns.form-handling: Form components handle validate and save events
required_patterns.id-required: Components must have unique id assigns

architectural_constraints.parent-communication: Communicate to parent via send(self(), message) or events
architectural_constraints.isolated-state: Components manage their own state, don't modify parent assigns directly

function-components.description: Stateless function components for UI building blocks

required_patterns.attr-declarations: Use attr macro to declare component attributes with types
required_patterns.slot-support: Use slot macro for content injection

architectural_constraints.no-state: Function components are pure - no assigns updates
architectural_constraints.reusable: Components should be generic and reusable across pages

required_patterns.changeset-function: Every schema has a changeset/2 function
required_patterns.field-types: Use appropriate Ecto types (Ecto.Enum for status fields)

architectural_constraints.no-business-logic: Schemas contain only data mapping and validation, not business logic
architectural_constraints.immutable-validation: Changesets validate but don't have side effects
architectural_constraints.virtual-fields: Use virtual: true for non-persisted fields like password

required_patterns.query-composition: Build queries using Ecto.Query macros (from, where, preload)
required_patterns.preload-explicit: Preload associations explicitly, don't rely on lazy loading
required_patterns.repo-aggregate: Use Repo.aggregate for counts and sums
required_patterns.soft-delete: Use deleted_at timestamp pattern for soft deletion

architectural_constraints.no-raw-sql: Use Ecto query DSL, avoid raw SQL when possible
architectural_constraints.context-only: Repo calls only in context modules or services

required_patterns.on-mount-hooks: LiveView auth via on_mount callbacks in router

architectural_constraints.session-tokens: Use database-backed session tokens, not stateless JWT
architectural_constraints.separate-api-auth: API routes use require_authenticated_user_api for JSON responses

required_patterns.json-view-modules: Separate JSON view modules (*_json.ex) for response formatting
required_patterns.scoped-routing: API routes under /api scope with proper pipelines

architectural_constraints.restful-actions: Follow REST conventions (index, show, create, update, delete)
architectural_constraints.json-responses: Return consistent JSON structure with success/error keys

required_patterns.subscribe-on-connect: Subscribe in mount when connected?(socket) is true

architectural_constraints.no-blocking-broadcasts: Broadcasts should not block main operations
architectural_constraints.local-pubsub: Uses local Phoenix.PubSub, no distributed Redis

gamification.description: XP, levels, and activity tracking system

required_patterns.xp-rewards: XP values defined in @xp_rewards module attribute

architectural_constraints.streak-calculation: Streaks calculated from activity dates, not stored
architectural_constraints.level-sync: User level always derived from XP, kept in sync

required_patterns.fixture-functions: Use fixture modules for test data creation
required_patterns.conn-case: Controller tests use ConnCase for connection setup
required_patterns.data-case: Context tests use DataCase for database setup
required_patterns.describe-blocks: Group related tests with describe blocks

architectural_constraints.sandbox-mode: Tests run in Ecto SQL sandbox mode
architectural_constraints.isolated-tests: Each test is independent, no shared state
architectural_constraints.async-where-possible: Use async: true when tests don't share resources

required_patterns.live-session: Group LiveViews in live_session with shared on_mount hooks

architectural_constraints.auth-in-pipeline: Authentication plugs in pipeline, not individual routes
architectural_constraints.verified-routes: Use ~p sigil for type-safe route generation
architectural_constraints.admin-protection: Admin routes require both authentication and admin role check
